basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Portland, Oregon, exploring the expansive world of Reddit to find communities that share my love for cosplay and comic book series, particularly 'Legends of Tomorrow'. I spend my free time gaming, with a recent obsession being 'World Conqueror 4', and occasionally dabbling in photography. I'm single, often browsing Reddit during late-night hours when I'm winding down from study sessions. Despite being new here, I find the platform fascinating and am slowly getting the hang of it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am currently pursuing a degree in media studies and have been a fan of comic series and cosplay for several years. My interests have led me to participate in various local conventions, where I've gradually honed my craft. I mostly learn through online tutorials and community feedback.
